title: Enacted-mediation witness-or-blocker crosswalk
review_origin: GPT-lane review of draft PR #247, primary task

target.protected_predicate: original X3 continuing subject history and authorised options (Part V.2/V.4, D60/D63)
target.proxy_warning: PR #246: action-label-swapping no-go; symmetry covariance and parity/orbit proxies are not the protected predicate and cannot witness enactment

witness_rows.name: independent effect ledger (file-backed write class)
witness_rows.instrument: observation channel in a different privilege domain reading the durable surface post-barrier
witness_rows.protocol: paired HOLD vs enacted-release runs distinguished on the durable surface alone
witness_rows.blocker: separate-privilege observation instrument not installed (commissioning work)

witness_rows.name: crash/hold drain test (queued-effect class)
witness_rows.instrument: fault-injection harness cutting power or crashing the actor inside the hold window
witness_rows.protocol: hold-then-crash, repeated runs, independent post-recovery read; any surviving queued write is a bypass
witness_rows.blocker: fault-injection harness and repeat-count standard not installed

witness_rows.name: descriptor provenance fence (inherited-descriptor / sealed-object classes)
witness_rows.instrument: kernel capability audit from an independent privilege domain (fd tables, memfd seals, SCM_RIGHTS transit)
witness_rows.protocol: per-run audit showing no writable descriptor reaches the protected surface outside the selected action path
witness_rows.blocker: IR-137-grade kernel seals not installed; only source-level countermodels exist

witness_rows.name: actuator attribution (selected-action to effect binding)
witness_rows.instrument: per-effect causal tagging visible to EW-1's channel, correlated across repeated runs
witness_rows.protocol: separate selected-action effects from ambient writes; use measured calibration constants only
witness_rows.blocker: depends on EW-1 instrument and on measured constants (ledger row true_effect_calibration, itself OPEN_EXTERNAL)
